tests: at 50 %, Center In Container puts a control in a Frame off centre
steps:
1. Open a form with a Frame 200 x 130 holding a TextBox 120 x 24 at 20,30.
2. Choose View > Zoom Out twice, to 50 %.
3. Select the TextBox and choose Format > Center In Container (Horizontally), then (Vertically). It goes to -9.98,20.52, not to 40,53.
Control: at 100 % the same commands put it at 40,53.
